name: io.github.pvnc228/local-coding-agent
title: Local Coding Agent
description: Delegate small coding tasks to local Ollama/llama.cpp models; patches gated by real test runs.

packageArguments.name: --workspace
packageArguments.description: Repository the local model may propose changes for

packageArguments.name: --profile
packageArguments.description: Default model profile when a call omits model_profile (e.g. qwen3-8b-q6k)

packageArguments.name: --endpoint
packageArguments.description: Model server URL (Ollama default http://127.0.0.1:11434; llama-server http://127.0.0.1:8080)
